shared_elements: low relief carving of figures in strict profile
processional repetition of near-identical figures moving in the same direction
overlapping figures arranged in a single register
patterned incised detail used to fill surfaces (curled hair/beard, fleece curls)
large-eyed profile heads with emphatic outlines
justification: Both show low-relief profile figures marching in the same direction in a single register, with overlapping bodies and the same convention of dense curled incision (tightly rolled beard/hair curls in A, identical spiral fleece and horn ridges in B), which is a fairly specific shared rendering habit. The decisive difference is the subject: A depicts a procession of robed human attendants framed by rosette bands, while B depicts a pair of horned rams with no human figures or ornamental borders.
